stem:
Photosynthesis is a process that results in the synthesis of complex organic molecules.

Respiration is a process that involves the breakdown of complex organic molecules.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
The light dependent stage of photosynthesis involves cyclic and non-cyclic photophosphorylation.

Describe **two** differences between cyclic and non-cyclic photophosphorylation.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem:
Biochemical processes involving carbon dioxide change the external environment of the aquatic plant, *Elodea canadensis*, and the pond snail, *Lymnaea stagnalis*. Carbon dioxide dissolves in water to form carbonic acid.

A student set up 8 test-tubes. Each test-tube contained $30\text{ cm}^3$ of distilled water containing a pH indicator, bromothymol blue.

Fig. 5.1 shows the experimental set up for these 8 test-tubes.

The test-tubes were left for 12 hours.

{{figure:figure_5_1.png}}

Fig. 5.1

Fig. 5.2 shows how the colour of bromothymol blue changes with pH.

{{figure:figure_5_2.png}}

Fig. 5.2

All tubes were green at the start of the experiment.

The results of the experiment are shown in Table 5.1.

Table 5.1

| test-tube | colour after 12 hours |
| :--- | :--- |
| 1 | green |
| 2 | blue |
| 3 | yellow |
| 4 | green |
| 5 | green |
| 6 | yellow-green |
| 7 | yellow |
| 8 | yellow |
